stories.title: AYM süresiz nafaka kararını iptal etti

en.title: Constitutional Court annuls indefinite alimony ruling
en.summary: Turkey's Constitutional Court invalidated a provision allowing indefinite alimony payments as unconstitutional. The annulment will take effect nine months after publication.

stories.title: Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı... AYM, 'süresiz nafaka' hükmünü iptal etti: 9 ay sonra yürürlüğe girecek

en.title: Constitutional Court annuls indefinite alimony ruling: to take effect in 9 months
en.summary: Turkey's Constitutional Court's decision to invalidate the indefinite post-divorce alimony provision was published in the Official Gazette. The ruling will take effect after nine months, with legal experts noting the decision does not prohibit alimony in all cases but requires clear judicial guidelines.
